component.name: PainelLateral
component.script: function init() as void m.painel = m.top.findNode("painel") m.lista = m.top.findNode("lista") m.lista.observeField("itemSelected", "onItem") m.top.findNode("focoTimer").observeField("fire", "aplicarFoco") m.top.observeField("opcoes", "onOpcoes") m.top.observeField("aberto", "onAberto") end function function onOpcoes() as void raiz = CreateObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") for each o in m.top.opcoes n = raiz.CreateChild("ContentNode") n.title = o.titulo if o.detalhe <> invalid then n.description = o.detalhe end for m.lista.content = raiz end function function onAberto() as void m.top.findNode("tituloLabel").text = m.top.titulo m.top.findNode("ajudaLabel").text = m.top.ajuda m.painel.visible = m.top.aberto if m.top.aberto then t = m.top.findNode("focoTimer") t.control = "start" else ' Devolve o foco à tela: lista escondida com foco prende todas as teclas. m.top.getParent().setFocus(true) end if end function function aplicarFoco() as void m.lista.setFocus(true) end function function onItem() as void m.top.escolhido = m.lista.itemSelected end function function onKeyEvent(key as String, press as Boolean) as Boolean if not press or not m.top.aberto then return false if key = "back" or key = "left" then m.top.aberto = false return true end if return true end function
